cohort_note: Partial cohort: the ECOD inputs were unavailable. Re-run with ALL_LAYER_COHORT=full when they return. Pooled metrics here are not comparable to full-cohort tables.
description: Frozen protocol-2.0 shared-OLS probes replayed across all 48 Evoformer layers without refitting; fold-f probes evaluate fold-f held-out proteins at the target layer. Signed error is probe distance minus final structure distance.
gates_not_applicable: pooled, fold, and subgroup parity with the producer and ten-layer run, which pool all 552 proteins
mode_definition: source intercept + ((x - target_mean)/target_scale) @ source_coef_std; target scaler is the same-fold train-only scaler from the target-layer artifact
regression_target: OpenFold final predicted structure C-alpha distance
